::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Oct 11th 1855  
**From:** Otterbourn  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection,  C0171: Box 29.
:::

My dear [Sir](people/person_1143.qmd)
I am much obliged for the draft for [£300](organizations/other_160.qmd) which I received this morning as well as for the book which accompanied it.

I am glad to hear that the [Lances of Lynwood](cmy_books/cmybook_23.qmd) have begun to go off so fast

Yours truly
C M Yonge
